verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs present the DuckDB CLI as a supported way to connect directly to MotherDuck (docs-2), with documented local credential saving for CLI sessions (docs-20). The probe also points to the CLI install docs. However, this CLI is the upstream DuckDB shell rather than a MotherDuck-specific tool, and nothing shows it is designed for agentic or AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: a first-party MotherDuck CLI (for managing shares, Ducklings, Flights or Dives), AI/agent-oriented CLI features or machine-readable output, and independent hands-on corroboration.
